meta.range: 2026-09-19 00:00 to 2026-10-11 00:00 UTC (data exists from 2026-09-19 10:52 UTC; PostHog was installed that day)
meta.human_filter: sessions with >=1 $pageview, no event with $virt_is_bot = true, entry referrer not localhost:3456 / 127.0.0.1:3456 / *.vercel.app (unless a query says otherwise)
meta.caveat: Test-account cohort 580233 has 0 members, so team traffic is included (about 48 sessions from 4 devices with 10+ sessions each, Q24). Aggregates only.

queries.what: Data window and automated-traffic check over the requested 90 days
queries.range: 2026-07-12 00:00 to 2026-10-11 00:00 UTC (requested); data found only from 2026-09-19
queries.hogql: SELECT min(timestamp) AS first_event, max(timestamp) AS last_event, count() AS pageviews, uniq(properties.$session_id) AS sessions, uniq(person_id) AS persons, countIf(properties.$virt_is_bot = true) AS bot_pv, countIf(properties.$browser IS NULL OR properties.$browser = '') AS no_browser_pv, countIf(properties.$raw_user_agent ILIKE '%headless%') AS headless_pv, countIf(properties.$host NOT IN ('kheelona.com','store.kheelona.com','www.kheelona.com')) AS other_host_pv FROM events WHERE event = '$pageview' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-07-12 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00')

queries.what: Pageviews flagged as bots or with no browser, by PostHog traffic classification
queries.hogql: SELECT coalesce(properties.$virt_traffic_type,'(none)') AS traffic_type, coalesce(properties.$virt_traffic_category,'') AS cat, coalesce(properties.$virt_bot_name,'') AS bot, coalesce(properties.$browser,'(null)') AS browser, coalesce(properties.$device_type,'(null)') AS device_type, count() AS pv, uniq(properties.$session_id) AS sessions FROM events WHERE event = '$pageview' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND (properties.$virt_is_bot = true OR properties.$browser IS NULL OR properties.$browser = '') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 ORDER BY pv DESC LIMIT 50

queries.what: Sessions by entry referring domain (all sessions with a pageview, bots included)
queries.hogql: SELECT coalesce($entry_referring_domain,'(none)') AS ref, count() AS sessions, countIf($entry_hostname = 'store.kheelona.com') AS store_entry, min(toDate($start_timestamp)) AS first_day, max(toDate($start_timestamp)) AS last_day FROM sessions WHERE $start_timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND $start_timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND $pageview_count > 0 GROUP BY ref ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 60
queries.note: Two referrer hostnames are generalised in brackets: a US college learning-management host and the mid version's Vercel preview host (listed in wiki/site/url-map.md).

queries.what: PostHog's own channel type against entry UTM source and medium
queries.hogql: SELECT $channel_type AS channel, $entry_utm_source AS src, $entry_utm_medium AS med, count() AS sessions FROM sessions WHERE $start_timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND $start_timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND $pageview_count > 0 GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 60
queries.note: PostHog files 221 fbclid-only sessions as Organic Social; Q6 treats them as Meta clicks without UTM.

queries.what: Do sessions continue across kheelona.com and store.kheelona.com?
queries.hogql: SELECT countIf(apex_pv > 0) AS sessions_with_apex, countIf(store_pv > 0) AS sessions_with_store, countIf(apex_pv > 0 AND store_pv > 0) AS both_hosts, countIf(store_pv > 0 AND apex_pv = 0) AS store_only FROM (SELECT properties.$session_id AS sid, countIf(properties.$host = 'kheelona.com') AS apex_pv, countIf(properties.$host = 'store.kheelona.com') AS store_pv FROM events WHERE event = '$pageview' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') GROUP BY sid)

queries.what: Weekly human sessions by source group (weeks start Monday; the first week holds only 2026-09-19 and 09-20)
queries.hogql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(st, 1) AS week_mon, count() AS sessions, countIf(src_group = 'Paid social, tagged') AS paid_tagged, countIf(src_group = 'Meta click id, no UTM') AS meta_untagged, countIf(src_group = 'Direct') AS direct, countIf(src_group = 'Organic search') AS organic_search, countIf(src_group = 'ChatGPT') AS chatgpt, countIf(src_group NOT IN ('Paid social, tagged','Meta click id, no UTM','Direct','Organic search','ChatGPT')) AS other, uniq(device_id) AS unique_devices, countIf(store_pv > 0) AS store_sessions, countIf(form_started > 0) AS form_sessions, countIf(purchased > 0) AS purchase_sessions FROM ( SELECT properties.$session_id AS sid, min(timestamp) AS st, any(distinct_id) AS device_id, any(session.$entry_referring_domain) AS ref, coalesce(any(session.$entry_utm_source),'') AS us, coalesce(any(session.$entry_utm_medium),'') AS um, coalesce(any(session.$entry_fbclid),'') AS fbc, <SRC_GROUP, with 'Internal' / 'Instagram bio link' / 'Own site' labels> AS src_group, max(properties.$virt_is_bot = true) AS is_bot, countIf(event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host = 'store.kheelona.com' AND properties.$pathname NOT LIKE '/thanks%') AS store_pv, countIf(event = 'preorder_form_started') AS form_started, countIf(event = 'purchase') AS purchased, countIf(event = '$pageview') AS pvs FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND event IN ('$pageview','preorder_form_started','purchase') AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sid HAVING pvs > 0 AND is_bot = 0 AND src_group != 'Internal' ) GROUP BY week_mon ORDER BY week_mon
queries.src_group_expression: multiIf( ref IN ('localhost:3456','127.0.0.1:3456') OR ref LIKE '%vercel.app', 'Internal (local or preview)', um = 'paid', 'Paid social, tagged', fbc != '' AND us = '', 'Meta click id, no UTM', um = 'social', 'Instagram bio link (ig/social)', us = 'chatgpt.com' OR ref = 'chatgpt.com', 'ChatGPT', ref IN ('www.google.com','www.bing.com','duckduckgo.com','au.search.yahoo.com','com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox'), 'Organic search', ref IN ('l.facebook.com','m.facebook.com','www.facebook.com','instagram.com','l.instagram.com','www.threads.com','www.linkedin.com','com.twitter.android'), 'Organic social, other', ref IN ('kheelona.com','www.kheelona.com'), 'Own site (session restarted)', ref = '$direct' OR ref IS NULL, 'Direct', 'Referral')

queries.what: Headline baseline, paid vs not paid (human, non-internal sessions)
queries.hogql: SELECT paid, count() AS sessions, uniq(did) AS unique_devices, sum(pvs) AS pageviews, round(100*countIf(pvs = 1)/count(), 1) AS pct_single_pageview, round(quantile(0.5)(dur), 0) AS median_session_s, countIf(store_pv > 0) AS reached_store, countIf(form_started > 0) AS form_started, countIf(submit > 0) AS valid_submit, countIf(checkout > 0) AS order_created, countIf(purchased > 0) AS purchase FROM ( SELECT properties.$session_id AS sid, any(distinct_id) AS did, any(session.$session_duration) AS dur, if(coalesce(any(session.$entry_utm_medium),'') = 'paid' OR (coalesce(any(session.$entry_fbclid),'') != '' AND coalesce(any(session.$entry_utm_source),'') = ''), 'paid or Meta click', 'not paid') AS paid, any(session.$entry_referring_domain) AS ref, max(properties.$virt_is_bot = true) AS is_bot, countIf(event = '$pageview') AS pvs, countIf(event = '$pageview' AND properties.$host = 'store.kheelona.com' AND properties.$pathname NOT LIKE '/thanks%') AS store_pv, countIf(event = 'preorder_form_started') AS form_started, countIf(event = 'preorder_start') AS submit, countIf(event = 'begin_checkout') AS checkout, countIf(event = 'purchase') AS purchased FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') AND event IN ('$pageview','preorder_form_started','preorder_start','begin_checkout','purchase') AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sid HAVING pvs > 0 AND is_bot = 0 AND NOT (coalesce(ref,'') IN ('localhost:3456','127.0.0.1:3456') OR coalesce(ref,'') LIKE '%vercel.app') ) GROUP BY ROLLUP(paid)

SELECT cc, count() AS sessions, round(100*count()/sum(count()) OVER (), 1) AS pct, countIf(paid = 0) AS non_paid FROM ( SELECT properties.$session_id AS sid, argMin(properties.$geoip_country_code, timestamp) AS cc, if(coalesce(any(session.$entry_utm_medium),'') = 'paid' OR (coalesce(any(session.$entry_fbclid),'') != '' AND coalesce(any(session.$entry_utm_source),'') = ''), 1, 0) AS paid, any(session.$entry_referring_domain) AS ref, max(properties.$virt_is_bot = true) AS is_bot FROM events WHERE event = '$pageview' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') GROUP BY sid HAVING is_bot = 0 AND NOT (coalesce(ref,'') IN ('localhost:3456','127.0.0.1:3456') OR coalesce(ref,'') LIKE '%vercel.app') ) GROUP BY cc ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 8

queries.what: Devices with many repeat sessions (likely the team; cannot be confirmed)
queries.hogql: SELECT device, os, browser, sessions_per_device_bucket, count() AS devices, sum(sessions) AS sessions FROM ( SELECT distinct_id, argMin(properties.$device_type, timestamp) AS device, argMin(properties.$os, timestamp) AS os, argMin(properties.$browser, timestamp) AS browser, uniq(properties.$session_id) AS sessions, multiIf(sessions = 1, '1', sessions <= 3, '2-3', sessions <= 9, '4-9', '10+') AS sessions_per_device_bucket, max(properties.$virt_is_bot = true) AS is_bot FROM events WHERE event = '$pageview' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') GROUP BY distinct_id HAVING is_bot = 0 ) WHERE sessions_per_device_bucket IN ('4-9','10+') GROUP BY device, os, browser, sessions_per_device_bucket ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 20

queries.what: Device split after paid ads stopped (sessions from 2026-09-24), with and without the 4 devices that had 10+ sessions
queries.hogql: SELECT device, count() AS sessions, round(100*count()/sum(count()) OVER (), 1) AS pct, countIf(heavy = 0) AS excl_4_heavy_devices FROM ( SELECT properties.$session_id AS sid, argMin(properties.$device_type, timestamp) AS device, any(distinct_id) AS did, if(any(distinct_id) IN (SELECT distinct_id FROM events WHERE event = '$pageview' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-19 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') GROUP BY distinct_id HAVING uniq(properties.$session_id) >= 10), 1, 0) AS heavy, any(session.$entry_referring_domain) AS ref, max(properties.$virt_is_bot = true) AS is_bot FROM events WHERE event = '$pageview' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-24 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-11 00:00:00') GROUP BY sid HAVING is_bot = 0 AND NOT (coalesce(ref,'') IN ('localhost:3456','127.0.0.1:3456') OR coalesce(ref,'') LIKE '%vercel.app') ) GROUP BY device ORDER BY sessions DESC
